summary: Campus through-street kerb with no-stopping signs and no cars parked along it.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time signs on stretch
No cars parked along this kerb

best_section.where: South kerb of Hood Street beside the construction site, east end

drivers.seclusion: Flat east end has a construction site and university buildings alongside; no dwellings within 40 m, so seclusion itself is fine.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb abuts a footpath and construction fencing; no pull-off, so a van stands in the lane edge of a through street.
drivers.traffic: Campus road linking the car park and the tower precinct; steady vehicle traffic.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time signs 2.8 m and 6.5 m from the kerb line; no cars parked along it.
